idea-plugin.name: CHRONOVAULT
idea-plugin.description:
Snapshot, verify, and restore the exact moments when your code worked. CHRONOVAULT records verified checkpoints of your project — each gated by a real build/test health check — and lets you diagnose what broke and restore the last good state. Current work is always protected first, and if verification fails after a restore, CHRONOVAULT automatically rolls back to your pre-recovery state. Everything is stored locally in your project's .chronovault vault: no cloud, no accounts, no telemetry.

Commands

  • Checkpoint — record a verified snapshot of the current state.
  • What broke it? — diagnose the exact change since your last verified checkpoint.
  • Restore last good state — return to a verified checkpoint with automatic rollback protection.
  • Dashboard — an embedded CHRONOVAULT timeline, health, and recovery console right in the tool window (opens in your browser in older IDEs).
  • ChronoVault: Show protection status — current protection overview.

Requirements

The chronovault command-line tool must be available on your PATH. A system-wide install works out of the box; for a custom location set the CHRONOVAULT_CLI environment variable to the full path of the binary.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.3

  • Loopback-only dashboard. The embedded panel now routes all traffic strictly to the local 127.0.0.1 chronovault server; the JCEF browser blocks any navigation to other URLs, and the native panel talks only to the in-process server.
  • Functional native dashboard. When JCEF is unavailable the tool window now shows a live native console — status banner, checkpoint timeline, and one-click Checkpoint / Health / Diagnose / Restore — instead of a static message. Polls every 5s off the UI thread.
  • Dashboard server now exposes request(method, path) against the API and is covered by pure-JDK tests.
  • Time-machine themed dashboard (warp rings, stream flow, chrono halo) with reduced-motion support.

1.0.2

  • Embedded dashboard. The CHRONOVAULT tool window now loads the full temporal console in-place via JCEF: timeline with hover tooltips, health state map, storage visualization, recovery wizard and live SSE updates — no browser needed.
  • Restore now asks for confirmation before writing the verified checkpoint back; automatic rollback protection is unchanged.
  • "Open Dashboard" focuses the tool window; "Open Dashboard in Browser" keeps the classic browser experience for quick access or older JCEF-less IDEs.
  • Graceful native fallback (action toolbar + Open-in-Browser) when JCEF or the CLI runtime is unavailable.
  • The dashboard server runs on a free loopback port and is stopped when the project closes.

1.0.1

  • CHRONOVAULT Tool Window for one-click access (checkpoint, health, diagnose, restore, dashboard).
  • Reliable CLI runtime discovery (PATH, user-scoped locations, macOS/Linux/Windows) with a clear message instead of a bare "not found".
  • All existing commands and recovery behavior unchanged.

1.0.0

  • Verified checkpoints gated by real build/test health checks.
  • What-broke-it diagnosis against the last verified checkpoint.
  • Restore with protective snapshot and automatic rollback on verification failure.
  • Temporal web dashboard with SSE-driven recovery wizard, timeline and state map.
  • Local-first, content-addressable vault with deduplication. No telemetry.
